mailhub.intro: Connect your mail, calendar and contacts with one tap. Vitana can then read your emails, see your appointments and find your contacts — only for the apps you switch on here.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.what: Vitana reads and writes emails for you

outlook-mail.name: Outlook Mail
outlook-mail.what: Read your Microsoft inbox and send mail

apple-mail.name: Apple Mail (iCloud)
apple-mail.what: Read your iCloud inbox and send mail from your iCloud address

google-calendar.name: Google Calendar
google-calendar.what: See and add events, kept in step with Vitanaland

outlook-calendar.name: Outlook Calendar
outlook-calendar.what: See and add events, kept in step with Vitanaland

outlook-contacts.name: Outlook Contacts
outlook-contacts.what: Bring your Outlook contacts into Vitanaland

apple-calendar.name: Apple Calendar (iCloud)
apple-calendar.what: See and add events, kept in step with Vitanaland

iphone-contacts.name: iPhone Contacts (iCloud)
iphone-contacts.what: Bring your iCloud contacts into Vitanaland

android-contacts.name: Android Contacts

apple.title: Connect Apple iCloud
apple.intro: Apple only lets other apps use iCloud Mail, Calendar and Contacts with an app-specific password. You set it up once and it works for all three Apple apps.
apple.step2: Open “Sign-In and Security” → “App-Specific Passwords” and create one named “Vitanaland”.
apple.step3: Enter your Apple ID and the new password here.
apple.privacy: We store the password encrypted. Vitana uses it to read your mail, calendar and contacts, to send mail when you ask it to, and to keep your “Vitanaland” calendar up to date. You can revoke it at Apple at any time.
apple.wrongPassword: Apple refused the sign-in — check your Apple ID and the app-specific password
apple.unreachable: iCloud can't be reached right now — try again in a moment

android.title: Open it on your Android phone
android.body: Android contacts come straight from your phone. Open Vitanaland in Chrome on your Android phone and tap the switch there — you choose which contacts come in.

off.title: Turn off {app}?

body.mail: Vitana will no longer read or send email through this app.
body.calendar: The busy times from this calendar disappear from your Vitanaland calendar. The “Vitanaland” calendar stays in your account — you can delete it there.
body.contacts: No new contacts will come in. Contacts already added stay unless you remove them here.

off.removeContacts: Also remove the added contacts from Vitanaland

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage your apps.
errors.loadFailed: Your apps couldn't be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.

status.off: Turn it on in Connected Apps first

connect.title: {app} isn't connected yet
connect.body: Turn {app} on once in Connected Apps. After that, you can find your friends here with one tap.

oauth_failed.title: The connection didn't work
oauth_failed.body: Your account couldn't be reached just now. Try again in a moment, or reconnect it in Connected Apps.

api_unavailable.title: Not possible on this device
api_unavailable.body: Your browser can't open your address book. Open Vitanaland in Chrome on your Android phone, or connect Google or iCloud.

permission_denied.title: No access to your contacts
permission_denied.body: Allow Vitanaland to access your contacts in your phone's settings.

rate_limited.title: Too many tries
rate_limited.body: Wait a moment, then try again.

cancelled.title: No contacts picked
cancelled.body: Tap again and pick the contacts you want to bring in.

consent.title: How we handle your contacts
consent.subtitle: Before you look for friends
consent.noAutoTitle: We never message anyone on our own
consent.noAutoBody: You decide who to contact and when.
consent.privateBody: Contacts you bring in are stored in your Vitanaland account. Only you can see them.
consent.removeBody: In Connected Apps you can turn a source off and remove its contacts.
consent.helper: We compare e-mail addresses to show who's already on Vitanaland. People who aren't are never told.
